//: Mountain State Miles — RTDB rules for the Portal (username/password in DB, NO Firebase Auth).
//_merge: MERGE into your existing rules. Keep your crosscountry rules. Deploy in Firebase Console > Realtime Database > Rules. THIS is the file to paste — the whole thing under 'rules'.
//_warning: Because this login does NOT use Firebase Auth, every request is unauthenticated (auth == null). RTDB rules cannot identify a specific user, so they can only allow-or-deny by path shape. Accounts are readable/writable per exact username key but the folder itself cannot be listed. Passwords are SHA-256 hashed client-side. Lightweight scheme for a low-stakes site, NOT bank-grade security — anyone who knows a username could overwrite that account.

crosscountry.//: Public read for XC data as the rest of the site relies on.

portal_accounts.//: Folder is NOT listable (can't dump every account). Access is per single username key.

$userKey.//: Read/write a single account by exact key. Sign-up creates it (role is null at first, which is allowed); onboarding later sets role to athlete/coach/fan.
